contracts: One installer per harness and machine serves startup and manual consumers. Repeated enrollment is accepted without creating another installer.
New sessions start once after completion, including update failure. Existing sessions reload only on successful manual update.
Skipped manual requests report the current operation, even if every requested agent was skipped.
Updater destruction retains QObject ownership and process-group cleanup; stopGroup does not invoke completion callbacks.
